title: Umi-Time Specification
description: The canonical, self-contained specification for the Umi-Time standard. Umi-Time gives us one shared number for the exact same instant globally, while presenting it in a way that is locally meaningful across visual, textual, and digital interfaces. This specification defines the Umi‑Time standard: a 360‑umi representation of the UTC day, its exact conversion to and from UTC, and the layered framework used to provide locally meaningful presentation.
